dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think that's the problem...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Really? Then why does everyone leave before the story even gets going?

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: Some guests from afar have even said that the stories aren't as fresh as those from Liyue about gods descending to the battlefield or maid-knights fighting against giant mechanical beasts and the like...

dialogues.speaker: Maddah
dialogues.text: But those stories sound simply outrageous! I find it really hard to accept a story that can't immerse listeners with a sense of realism.
